invariants.rationale: instantTime is required for identifying the commit/instant for the update and is likely never null.
partitionPath is needed to locate the records; a null partition is likely disallowed in practice.
fileId is needed to identify the data file to update; null fileId is unlikely to be valid.
Updates require a mapping from keys to records; the map should not be null.
oldDataFile points to the base file being updated and should not be null for update processing.
